lines.japanese: よう、小鳩──
lines.english: Hey, Kobato—

lines.japanese: ──と思ったら、なんだ、おまえか。
lines.english: —oh. It's only you.

lines.japanese: いやあ、最近ヘンな夢を見ることが多くてな。
lines.english: See, I've been having a lot of strange dreams lately.

lines.japanese: どんなって、たとえば俺がブモンガだったり、グレタガルドの勇者だったり、まあ色々ヘンな夢だ。
lines.english: What kind? Dreams where I'm Bumonga, or a hero of Gretagard. All kinds of strange things.

lines.japanese: そんな中でも、小鳩の出てくる夢がとりわけ多いものだから、夢といえば小鳩が出てくるものとばかり、つい早合点してしまった。すまん、すまん──
lines.english: And so many of them feature Kobato that I jumped to the conclusion that every dream must have her in it. Sorry about that—

lines.japanese: ──って、これ、夢だよね？
lines.english: —this is a dream, right?

lines.japanese: うーん、夢じゃないと困るんだよな……。
lines.english: Hmm. It would be a problem if it weren't...

lines.japanese: かつて俺の中の誰かは、他の誰かに生きる力を分けあたえてしまったため、魂の牢獄に永らく囚われていた。
lines.english: Once, someone inside me gave another someone the strength to live and found himself imprisoned in the soul's jail for a very long time.

lines.japanese: 言いかえれば奈落の底で、都合のいい追憶と夢想ばかり縫合したまやかしの楽園に溺れていたんだ。
lines.english: Put another way, he drowned at the bottom of the abyss in a false paradise stitched together from convenient memories and fantasies.

lines.japanese: しかしいまの俺は、かつてバラバラだった俺が力を合わせることで薔薇色の世界に生まれなおした、ブランニュー俺だ。
lines.english: But now, with all the scattered pieces of me working together, I’ve been reborn into a rosy world. I’m a brand-new me.

lines.japanese: いまさら夢テレビやら夢ラジオやら、非生産的な世界へ後戻りするわけにはいかない。
lines.english: I can't go crawling back to an unproductive world of dream television and dream radio now.

lines.japanese: というわけで、もう一度聞こう。ここ、奈落じゃないよな？
lines.english: So I'll ask again. This isn't the abyss, is it?

lines.japanese: そうか、なら結構、改めまして──
lines.english: Good. Then let me begin properly—

lines.japanese: ──よう末っ子、久しぶりだな。調子はどうだい。
lines.english: —hey, youngest brother. Been a while. How've you been?

lines.japanese: 俺は上々さ。知ってるだろ。
lines.english: I'm doing great. You already know that.

lines.japanese: いろんな俺がひとつになった俺は、ちょっと不安定な時期もあったけれど──
lines.english: There was a slightly unstable period after all the different versions of me became one—

lines.japanese: ──ふるさとの街へおもむき、過去と向きあい、自分たちの根源を見つめなおすことで、いまはひとりの全き俺に落ちついている。
lines.english: —but I visited our hometown, confronted the past, and looked again at our roots. Now I've settled into one complete self.

lines.japanese: むかし、じいちゃんが言ってた。
lines.english: Gramps once told us.

lines.japanese: 消えるわけじゃない、みんなひとつになるんだ、って。
lines.english: Nobody would disappear. We would all become one.

lines.japanese: まさにそのとおり、俺たちは全員ここにいる。ヨージも伽桜羅もタカシも鷲介も隼人も、誰ひとり欠けることなく、ここにいる──
lines.english: He was exactly right. We're all here. Youji, Karura, Takashi, Shuusuke, Hayato—every one of us is here, with nobody missing—

lines.japanese: ──ああ悪い、べつにおまえの存在を忘れたわけじゃないんだ。
lines.english: —oh, sorry. I didn't forget that you exist.

lines.japanese: ただ、なあ……？　結局おまえだけは、俺なのか俺じゃないのか最後までよく分からなかったし……あ、でも、今こうして話してるってことは最後じゃないのか？　ん？
lines.english: It's only... well, you know? I never did figure out whether you were me or not, right to the very end... Wait. If we're talking now, was that really the end? Hm?

lines.japanese: ま、なんでもいいか。俺はいつでも友達募集中。面白いやつは大歓迎なんだ。
lines.english: Oh, who cares. I'm always looking for friends, and interesting people are especially welcome.

lines.japanese: 主役は俺たち。舞台は薔薇色の世界。キャメラは頼もしきおまえだ。そして肝心要のヒロインは──
lines.english: We're the heroes. The stage is a rosy world. You're our trusty camera. And the all-important heroine is—

lines.japanese: ──う、うん、まあ、それは、あいつしかいないよね。
lines.english: —y-yeah. I mean, it could only be her, right?

lines.japanese: あ、いや、べつに俺、ロリコンとかシスコンとかってわけじゃないけどさ。でも、だって、なあ？　あの子、いちばんヒロインってカンジじゃん？　ワタライ？　誰それ。
lines.english: No, I don't have a Lolita complex or a sister complex. But come on. Doesn't she feel more like a heroine than anyone else? Watarai? Who's that?

lines.japanese: というわけで、これは俺たちと小鳩の物語。
lines.english: And so this is the story of us and Kobato.

lines.japanese: 俺たちに翼はないこともなかったんだなあ、っていう物語だぞ。
lines.english: A story about how maybe we didn't entirely lack wings after all.
